skills.name: delivery-closer
skills.summary: Completes and proves an explicitly authorized terminal delivery action after implementation.
skills.portability: Format-level compatible with standard Agent Skills hosts; requires current host-visible state, explicitly authorized mutations, and proportional evidence. It does not edit implementation artifacts or delegate.

skills.name: delivery-verification
skills.summary: Returns an evidence-based PASS/FAIL when material uncertainty remains after implementation.
skills.portability: Most portable; format-level compatible with standard Agent Skills hosts. Runtime needs host-available evidence and tools, and the skill never edits artifacts.

skills.name: design-intelligence
skills.summary: Guides significant UI/UX work with product-specific direction and practical visual verification.
skills.portability: Conditional on host file access; the design-taste memory is optional.

skills.name: lightweight-windows-app
skills.summary: Builds, changes, fixes and releases lightweight C#/WPF Windows tray apps, widgets and modules with an original design system and proof on the installed exe.
skills.portability: Format-level compatible with standard Agent Skills hosts, but Windows-only at runtime: needs the .NET SDK, Windows PowerShell 5.1 and Inno Setup 6, and targets .NET Framework 4.8. Its scaffold and scripts were exercised on Windows 11 from Claude Code desktop on 2026-11-06, and not under Codex or Cursor.
